Name: Durumi Hut - Harvest Helpers and Bucket Watering
Author: asb3967
Description:
[b]Durumi Hut 1.3.0[/b]
The same helpers who work in your fields now have a place at the dining table and a pillow of their own. Visit at midday to catch them eating, or after 9 pm to see them settle under the patchwork quilt. The base hut has two residents and an expanded hut has three.

The new room follows the creator's illustrated layout, from the continuous kitchen counter to the tea table by the hearth. Chairs and bedding have separate foreground pieces so helpers sit behind the slats and sleep beneath the quilt. The indoor harvest box opens the hut's shared 36-slot storage. Meals are a visual activity and do not consume your crops.

[b]Build and upgrade[/b]
Robin offers construction without progression, year or season unlocks. Normal shop hours and construction scheduling apply.
Base hut costs 20,000g, 200 stone, 9 starfruit and 100 fiber and takes two days. Two helpers harvest a 13x13 area centered on the entrance.
First upgrade costs 5,000g, 100 wood and 100 stone and takes one day. Three helpers harvest a 17x17 area.
Second upgrade costs 10,000g, 200 stone, 5 iron bars and 10 hardwood and takes two days. It adds a small well and bucket watering with the same three helpers and 17x17 area.

[b]Field work and weather[/b]
Helpers fill at the well, carry water to crops and pour before the soil becomes wet. A bucket waters up to eight targets before refilling. Filling, walking and pouring take time. Watering runs from 6 am until 7 pm and stops in rain.
Native harvest restrictions apply in rain, winter and traditional festivals. Harvesting and watering share the same helpers. Helpers start rainy mornings indoors, and wear raincoats to return through the door if caught outside. Idle winter helpers rest indoors and wear winter outfits for watering jobs.

[b]Install and update[/b]
Requires your own Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. Close the game. Move the previous DurumiHut folder outside Mods, then extract the new DurumiHut folder into Mods and launch through SMAPI. Dedicated installations use DurumiHut-Standalone/Mods. The ZIP includes source and a quick-start guide in all twelve languages.
Items obstructed by the updated interior are recovered at the Mayor's Lost and Found. Back up saves before updating.
The previous optional Windows installer remains quarantined by Nexus and has security-engine detections that have not been established as false positives. Use this standard ZIP and SMAPI from smapi.io.

[b]Languages and AI disclosure[/b]
Construction menus, all furniture names and room interactions follow the language selected in Stardew Valley. Includes English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese. AI-assisted translations were tested for in-game display. Full native-speaker proofreading is unverified.
This unofficial Drami fan creation uses AI-assisted code, artwork and translations. OpenAI Codex/GPT-6 Astra assisted development and review. The user supplied the Durumi setting, illustrated room and art direction. Durumi is a ten-year-old child with an androgynous appearance. AI-Generated Content and AI Media tags apply. Screens labeled actual gameplay are captures from the game. Older gallery images retain their version labels.

[b]Credits and removal[/b]
Stardew Valley by ConcernedApe. SMAPI by Pathoschild and contributors. The game is required and its proprietary files are not included in the mod ZIP.
Before removing the mod, empty storage, leave the room, demolish all Durumi Huts through Robin with the mod enabled, and save a day. Then close the game and remove the mod folder.
Verified on Windows single-player. Multiplayer and combinations with other Junimo overhauls remain unverified. Please omit private save and account data from public bug reports.
